title: leptochilus subhemionitideus
intro: Leptochilus subhemionitideus, commonly known as Hemionitis plant, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
